sources.title: E-Consulat: Visa application
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Migration and Tunisians Abroad
sources.officialityEvidence: The live E-Consulat page identifies the Ministry in its header and gives the current consular process for nationalities subject to visas, without naming them.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les personnes de nationalités soumises à la procédure de visa doivent prendre contact avec les Consulats de Tunisie.

sources.title: Presidency of Government: electronic-visa project meeting
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Presidency portal records the project as a platform to be designed and says later measures would be announced by the competent ministries.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois mis en place, ce système facilitera l’obtention de visas

sources.title: Ministry of Social Affairs: foreign-entry guide
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry-hosted guide records the treaty-qualified three-month visa waiver, but is not a current nationality schedule or agreement register.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sont dispensés du visa ... les ressortissants des États ayant conclu ... des conventions.
